notes:
High-level account summary:
- Vertical: internal engineering platform for large mono-repo code search + developer knowledge base.
- Primary constraint: very large embedding corpus (~30M embeddings initially; expect growth to 150M over 12 months). Frequent re-indexing: nightly incremental + full weekly reindex.
- Latency target: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 200ms for retrieval+rerank path on typical dev query (short queries, embedding vector dim 1536).
- Throughput: baseline 1M queries/day, peak bursts up to 5K qps for CI-triggered search jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: engineering org calculated acceptable incremental cost ~$0.0007/query for retrieval+rankeval during eval; target production <$0.0004/query.
- Model preferences: prefer open models; will accept a quantized reranker if quality meets thresholds. Want routing fallback to cheaper variant when latency SLO endangered.
- Deployment: must support VPC initial rollout; roadmap includes on-prem for gov/private deployments. Key management via customer KMS required.
- Security: strict SSO/SAML + SCIM for user provisioning, audit logging retained 1 year, ability to tag/query logs by route and token.
- Quote from VP eng: "Search needs to feel instant for devs; if it's slow they'll stop using it and we'll build something ad-hoc."
- Internal doc ask: Redwood to produce an internal engineering brief that explains indexing topology, reindex strategies (cold vs warm shards), cache invalidation behavior, and expected tokenized cost per query for 10M/50M/150M corpora.
- POC plan: 1) Validate latency on 10M subset with dedicated pool; 2) Reindex cadence test (nightly delta + weekly full) with observed uplift on CPU/GPU usage; 3) Reranker ablation vs baseline vector-only recall; 4) Cost modeling and autoscaling policy verification.
- Observations: infra prefers deterministic rollouts and pinning model versions; wants ability to route heavy jobs to lower-cost region during off-peak.
- Sales note: procurement expects price benchmarking against Pinecone and self-hosted Faiss (Ops cost included). Keep dedicated vs private TCO scenarios separate.
- Docs linked: security FAQ, pricing deck, sample reindex playbook (drive).
requirements_summary: Short form: large-scale embeddings (30M -> 150M), nightly re-index, p99 retrieval+rerank <200ms, 1M daily queries baseline, SSO/SAML + KMS + audit logs, prefer open model variants and quantization recommendations, cost target <$0.0004/query at scale. Must support VPC first, on-prem later.
poC_criteria: 1) p95 < 120ms and p99 < 200ms on 10M subset under realistic QPS; 2) Reranker improves MRR by >10% vs pure vector retrieval on internal eval set; 3) Reindex downtime <5% during weekly full reindex with acceptable CPU/GPU burst; 4) Cost model shows path to <$0.0004/query at 50M+ embeddings.
technical_questions_raised: How does Redwood handle incremental reindexing for embeddings at 30M+ scale? cold vs hot shard strategy?
Cache invalidation semantics for prefix/KV cache when code base changes frequently?
Support for vector store compaction and quantized index formats without sacrificing reranker input fidelity?
Network egress and cross-region routing controls for VPC/private deployments?
Operational debugging hooks: per-query trace ids, token-level cost breakdown, and reranker explainability?
final_notes_for_sales: Keep POC focused on engineering KPIs (latency, reindex cadence, rerank quality). Push Redwood Optimize package as separate line to model cost. Emphasize routing/fallback story and audit/SAML compliance. Need legal + security SSO checklist returned by 2026-03-25 to keep procurement on schedule.
